# noozle_sse_outlet (Resource)

Manages a Noozle SSE outlet.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.

resource "noozle_sse_outlet" "alerts" {
  name          = "SSE alerts"
  enabled       = true
  event_type    = "article.match"
  path          = "/v1/sse/stream/noozle-alerts"
  retry_ms      = 5000
  notify_policy = "ALL"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the outlet is active.
- `event_type` (String) SSE event type.
- `name` (String) Name presented for the outlet.
- `path` (String) SSE endpoint path.
- `retry_ms` (Number) SSE retry interval in milliseconds.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Optional note explaining the outlet purpose.
- `notify_policy` (String) Notification policy for routed matches. Use FIRST_ONLY to suppress duplicates or ALL to emit every match.

### Read-Only

- `applied_generation` (Number) Last observed applied config generation.
- `apply_status` (String) Observed apply/runtime status for the outlet.
- `config_generation` (Number) Desired outlet config generation.
- `id` (Number) Unique identifier of the outlet.
- `last_apply_error` (String) Last observed apply/runtime error message.
- `stream_url` (String) Stream URL for the SSE outlet.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.

terraform import noozle_sse_outlet.alerts 101
```
